research_question: Do the historical BIRD column-retrieval gaps reflect rank errors and token-budget pressure on a non-saturated candidate set, and is the current FK/Join-Instance metadata reliable enough to unlock later role/path work?
hypothesis: A fixed 1024-dimensional replay can reproduce the historical retrieval metrics and reveal per-database ranking, saturation, budget-fit, and FK coverage limits without changing the model, candidate text, or data.
stage: P1.5 offline diagnosis; exploratory BIRD dev evidence

data.dataset: BIRD dev, previously used development set; exploratory only
data.question_prompt: Instruct: Given a natural-language question about a database, retrieve the relevant tables and columns.\nQuery: {question}
data.gold_use: evaluation labels only; SQL is parsed only for FK coverage; neither enters candidate text or scoring

model_and_scoring.similarity: exact cosine via dot product; stable descending sort
model_and_scoring.budget_tokenizer: local Qwen tokenizer; passage text only; same greedy candidate ordering as historical P1

runs: one CPU-only full-input and FK preflight

success_criteria: All frozen question, schema, P0, Gold-label, SQLite/description, model-manifest, source-code, and historical-output hashes verify.
The five-question smoke completes with finite 1024-D vectors and valid rank/budget outputs.
The full replay reproduces the historical row-level P1 hit counts and 2048-token complete-coverage flags for 512/1024 prefixes.
Per-database saturation, Gold-rank, budget-oracle, error-feature, and stable FK-instance summaries are emitted with raw per-question artifacts kept local.
stop_conditions: Any frozen hash, candidate-text hash, or source-code hash mismatch.
Unavailable selected GPU, resource-budget breach, failed smoke, non-finite embeddings, or historical row-level metric mismatch.
Any output-path collision or unexpected SQL/data operation.
decision_rule: Do not run P2a in this experiment. After P1.5, permit only a separately frozen 1024-D Cosine/BM25/RRF comparison if the historical baseline reproduces, non-saturated column errors remain on reliable labels, and a runtime-visible error feature supports the comparison. FK failure blocks role/path claims independently.
